summary: feat(settings): record avatar page and avatar-menu sign-out in Glean
description:
Because:

* The Settings avatar page, avatar upload and avatar-menu sign-out had no Glean events.
* The sign-out navigation can drop queued Glean pings.

This commit:

* Adds account_pref avatar_view, avatar_upload_success and signout_success.
* Records each event beside its legacy event; legacy calls are unchanged.
* Awaits flushGlean() before the sign-out navigation.
* Adds unit tests and Glean assertions to the avatar functional spec.

Closes FXA-15119
